title: version-handoff-orchestrator-and-tenant-fenced-staggered-promotions
creator: Maya Chen
description: Implement a 'version handoff orchestrator' that performs tenant-fenced, staggered promotions of control plane versions for Private (VPC) deployments. The orchestrator will coordinate Terraform-driven infra changes, ephemeral shadow deployments, traffic mirroring for validation, and health-sampling windows before committing a promotion. Goal: zero-surprise upgrades with automated rollback triggers and clear observability for operators.
background: We regularly perform minor and patch control plane upgrades across customer VPCs. Current processes are manual and rely on ad-hoc scripts plus operators watching metrics. Previous canary frameworks targeted single clusters; for Private we need tenant isolation, low blast radius, and Terraform-native orchestration so upgrades are reproducible and auditable. This ticket builds an orchestrator service + TF modules wrapper to standardize promotions and integrate with Console telemetry and rollback policies.
acceptance_criteria: A reproducible orchestration run can promote control plane vX.Y.Z -> vX.Y.Z+1 for a single VPC in shadow mode without changing live traffic.
Promotion policy supports 'tenant-fenced' batches (configurable batch size and tenant selectors).

Automated health gates evaluate: control-plane API latency P95, reconcile error rate, webhook success rate, and operator-defined custom probes. If any gate fails, orchestrator halts and initiates automated rollback procedure.
All orchestration operations are driven by Terraform modules; state changes are committed to Terraform state with a clear audit trail.
Console shows per-run telemetry: step durations, metric deltas, and a linkable playbook (Confluence) and PR references.
Security review completed and KMS usage for any keys stored by the orchestrator is documented.
implementation_notes: Architecture: lightweight coordinator (Go) that invokes Terraform via a wrapped command API running in a controlled runner (GitHub Actions self-hosted or runner service). For each tenant batch: 1) provision shadow control plane variant in same VPC using infra module; 2) shadow-swap telemetry: mirror 2-5% of control-plane API traffic for 20m; 3) run health-sampling window and compare baseline metrics; 4) on success, apply promotion Terraform plan to flip target version tag; 5) post-promotion reconciliation and 1h observation window. Key components: terraform-modules/controlplane-version (new), orchestrator-service, console-integration webhook, rollback-runbook. Use feature flags to toggle automatic promotion vs manual approve.
plan: Design Terraform wrapper module and change proposal format (3 days)
Prototype orchestrator coordinator (Go) with fake-run mode and unit tests (5 days)
Integrate traffic mirroring and sampling pipeline (connect with envoy/istio or in-house sidecars) (4 days)
Wire Console telemetry and add per-run dashboard (2 days)
Security review and KMS/HSM integration (2 days)
End-to-end QA on staging VPCs and dry-run with canary customers (3 days)
Document runbook and automate rollback playbook (2 days)
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Shadow deployments could double resource usage and cost for a customer. Mitigation: default small footprint shadow instances + configurable cost cap in TF module.

Risk: Terraform drift between orchestrator-runner and customer-managed Terraform. Mitigation: use ephemeral workspaces and read-only verification mode before applying changes; require operator approval for force-applies.
Risk: Telemetry noise leads to false positives. Mitigation: use baseline comparison windows and require persistent degradation over multiple windows before triggering rollback.
Risk: Secrets leakage from orchestrator state. Mitigation: encrypt any stored state at rest via customer KMS; never persist raw secrets in logs.
telemetry_and_alerting: Emit per-run events to Console: orchestrator.run.start, orchestrator.step.complete, orchestrator.run.success/failed. Provide delta metrics: latency_p95_delta, reconcile_error_rate_delta, webhook_failure_rate_delta. Create PagerDuty escalation when run fails or rollback triggers. Add a Grafana dashboard template for run comparisons.
qa_and_test_plan: Unit tests for orchestrator, integration tests for terraform module using localstack-like mocks, e2e validation in staging VPCs with synthetic traffic generator. Run a pilot with two customers (opt-in) to validate production signals. Perform chaos tests where we kill control-plane leader during shadow window to ensure rollback safety.
